# Check for potential vulnerabilities in the zip file processing
def check_zip_file_vulnerabilities(zip_file)
  require 'zip'

  begin
    Zip::File.open(zip_file.path) do |zip|
      zip.each do |entry|
        # Check for potential zip bomb (very large files)
        if entry.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024 # 10 MB limit
          puts "Potential zip bomb detected: #{entry.name}"
          return false
        end
      end
    end
  rescue => e
    puts "Error processing zip file: #{e.message}"
    return
